info.title: Aiden Remote API
info.description: Normative Aiden On The Go REST/SSE contract. Filesystem paths and credentials are never wire identifiers.

x-aiden-context-private-response-fields.normalization: Remove hyphens, underscores, periods, and whitespace, then lowercase before comparison.

post.description: Returns the active pairing trust envelope encrypted under the locally displayed 100-bit setup code. The code is never sent in this request.

200.description: Chat moved to the selected workspace
Bounded raster image content owned by this chat
Bounded Bot summaries and authoritative favorite order; instructions are omitted
Bot identity, editable guidance, avatar, and safe access view

201.description: Existing canonical Bot chat returned, or one authoritative chat created when absent; 201 is retained for v1 client compatibility

200.description: Safe opaque Bot capability catalog; no paths, credentials, headers, or fingerprints
Authoritative Bot access policy after a revision-checked update
Authoritative inherited or Custom reduction for this Bot chat
Authoritative chat reduction; it can never exceed its Bot
Bounded file index authorized against the Bot chat and current policy epoch
Readable text document authorized against the Bot chat and current policy epoch
Bot detail after returning to the semantic avatar fallback
Updated authoritative favorite membership and order
Mac-owned Full Access notice acknowledgement status for this paired device
Current bounded approval snapshot for this stream

post.description: Resolve an approval owned by this device. Allowing schedule_task or edit_automation additionally requires schedule:write; clients without that grant may deny only.

200.description: Paired-Mac local speech engine and model status
Speech status after deleting the local model

post.description: Transcribes one explicit, bounded recording locally on the paired Mac. Audio is not retained and the current Parakeet model returns a final result only.

200.description: Privacy-safe aggregate usage from this Aiden Agent installation
Bounded diff from an immutable review snapshot
Worktrees without filesystem or Git-admin paths

202.description: Durable run accepted; socket loss does not cancel it

200.description: Enabled MCP server IDs and display names only

PairingBootstrap.description: Canonical bootstrap nested inside the locally displayed QR trust envelope.

acceptsDisplayName.description: Opt in to the additive displayName response field; omitted by legacy strict clients.

acceptsBotCapabilities.description: Explicitly accepts the Bot capability vocabulary and the additive serverCapabilities projection. Bot grants are never issued when this field is absent or false.

capabilities.description: Exact capabilities granted to this authenticated device.
Exact capabilities granted to the authenticated device.

serverCapabilities.description: Server-supported inventory. Present only for devices that explicitly negotiated the Bot capability vocabulary.

deviceName.description: Presentation-only label currently stored for the authenticated client device.

canAllow.description: False when exact privileged details are intentionally host-only or the device lacks a capability required to allow this mutation; mobile clients must offer Deny only.

supportsImages.description: Whether this configured model accepts image input.
